working_definition: Nuclei of the authors' 'Cell body glial cell' cluster(s) (Saavedra et al. 2023, Figure 3a), dissected adult male thoraces, control genotype.

best_match.fbbt_term: adult VNC cell body glial cell
best_match.fbbt_definition: Any glial cell (FBbt:00005144) that is part of some adult ventral nerve cord cell body rind (FBbt:00111082).

justification: The authors' annotation 'Cell body glial cell' (Fly Cell Atlas-based). Cell body glia are CNS-only and the thorax's CNS is the ventral nerve cord, so the VNC term is exact (FCA rule).
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00059288 adult VNC cell body glial cell (exact match).
